title: Mission: Button Golfer
subtitle: Build the golfer and learn how it swings.
summary: Meet the button golfer, learn its parts, and press the button to swing the club.
activityInstruction: Press the button to make the golfer swing the club and hit the ball.

storyQuestions.prompt: What are we trying to move?
storyQuestions.success: We are trying to move the golf ball.

storyQuestions.prompt: Where do we want the ball to go?
storyQuestions.success: We want the ball to go into the hole.

storyQuestions.prompt: Can we touch the ball with our hands?
storyQuestions.success: We cannot touch the ball with our hands.

storyQuestions.prompt: What happens if we hit the ball too softly?
storyQuestions.success: A soft hit makes the ball stop too soon.

storyQuestions.prompt: What happens if we hit the ball too hard?
storyQuestions.success: A hard hit makes the ball go too far.

storyQuestions.prompt: What do we need to build?
answers: Something that can hit the ball toward the hole
Something that can carry the ball
Something that can hide the ball
storyQuestions.success: We need to build something that can hit the ball toward the hole.

quiz.prompt: Where does the ball need to go?
quiz.success: The ball goes toward the hole.

parts.label: Hat
parts.fact: The golfer wears a cap to block the sun.

parts.label: Head
parts.fact: The head holds the eyes that watch the ball.

parts.label: Body
parts.fact: The body holds the golfer together.

parts.label: Arms
parts.fact: The arms hold the club and swing it.
parts.help: The parts that hold the club.

parts.label: Club
parts.fact: The club hits the ball toward the hole.
